questions.q: What does Glue Studio's visual canvas actually produce?
options: A generated PySpark script running as a real Glue job, which you can view and edit directly
A completely separate runtime that doesn't use Spark at all
A static diagram with no executable output
A Redshift stored procedure
questions.explain: Glue Studio generates a real, viewable/editable PySpark script — it's a visual front end for authoring an ordinary Glue job.

questions.q: What are the three node types in Glue Studio's visual graph model?
options: Source, transform, and target
Input, output, and cache
Crawler, catalog, and trigger
Read, write, and delete
questions.explain: Glue Studio pipelines are built from source nodes, one or more transform nodes, and target nodes.

questions.q: Since a Glue Studio job is still a real Glue job underneath, what does it share with a hand-written PySpark job?
options: It runs as serverless Spark, is billed in DPU-hours, and can use job bookmarks, triggers, and workflows
It runs on a dedicated EC2 instance instead of serverless compute
It cannot use job bookmarks at all
It is billed at a flat monthly rate regardless of usage
questions.explain: Because Glue Studio produces a normal Glue job, it inherits the same serverless Spark execution, DPU billing, and feature set as a hand-written job.

questions.q: According to this lesson, when is a hand-written PySpark script generally a better fit than Glue Studio's visual builder?
options: When logic involves intricate branching, custom Python libraries, or fine-grained performance tuning
Whenever the job simply reads a table and writes it back out unchanged
Glue Studio can never be used for any real production job
Only when a Scala Spark job is required
questions.explain: Complex conditional logic, custom libraries, and detailed performance tuning are easier to express directly in code than as chained visual nodes.

questions.q: What transform option does Glue Studio provide when no dedicated visual node covers what you need?
options: A custom SQL query node against the in-flight data
There is no way to handle anything beyond the built-in visual nodes
You must switch to a completely different AWS service
A manual file upload of a compiled JAR
questions.explain: Glue Studio supports a custom SQL transform node for logic that doesn't have a dedicated built-in visual transform.
